response.justification: While Bogdan is a proven senior-level engineer with strong architectural skills and diverse technical experience, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. The position explicitly demands deep C++ expertise with industrial automation domain knowledge. His last substantial C++ work was over a decade ago (2014-2015), and his entire recent career has focused on TypeScript, Node.js, and web/cloud technologies. Most critically, he lacks any exposure to industrial automation, IoT applications, or industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, SDL)—all central to this role. The combination of outdated C++ skills and complete absence of industrial domain expertise makes this unsuitable despite his evident engineering maturity.
strengths: 20-year track record of architectural expertise and ability to design complex, scalable systems across multiple technical domains
Proven hands-on leadership with Node.js, React, and cloud platforms, including experience optimizing high-performance, real-time systems
Excellent technical communication and mentoring skills evidenced through workshops, conference talks, and active open-source community contributions
concerns: C++ expertise is severely outdated—last worked with it in 2014-2015; recent career continues to move away from systems programming toward web technologies
No exposure to industrial automation, IoT applications, or industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, SDL) required for this role's core focus
Entire recent career (10+ years) has focused on web and cloud platforms rather than on-premises embedded or industrial control systems
